patch_list: Routes Google Play Services to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) and pins Poke Genie's legacy sign-in path so Google sign-in works on the re-signed app. Install MicroG-RE, add your account there. Minimal: no push/FCM.

Neutralizes PairIP's startup program (integrity check + Play-Store paywall) and restores its obfuscation tables, while leaving the native VM intact so virtualized methods still run. Also nukes the Java license/signature checks. Required by…
Forces premium flags and server getters to true/max by short-circuiting their methods.
